class_name EffectScriptParser
extends RefCounted
## 影之诗：超凡世界标准规范用语通用效果解析器 (EffectScriptParser)
## 让用户在「卡牌设计器」中按规范用语编写的任何新卡牌 JSON 无需修改代码即可自动解析并执行效果！
##
## 支持的标准规范用语语法（可自由组合多句，以句号「。」或换行分隔）：
## 1. 抽牌与检索：
##    - "抽取X张卡牌" / "从牌库抽取X张「种族」随从"
## 2. 衍生物与手牌生成：
##    - "将X张『卡名』加入手牌" / "将X张和本随从同名的随从加入手牌"
## 3. 战场召唤、招募与亡者召还：
##    - "召唤X个『卡名』到战场上" / "召唤1张和本随从同名的卡牌加入战场"
##    - "【招募_能量X】仅限「种族」，发动Y次"
##    - "【亡者召还_能量X】仅限「种族」，发动Y次"
## 4. 伤害、破坏、消失、变身与恢复：
##    - "选择对手的战场上的1个随从，对其造成X点伤害"
##    - "对对手的战场上的所有随从造成X点伤害"
##    - "对对手的主战者造成X点伤害"
##    - "回复自己的主战者X点生命值"
##    - "选择1个生命值X以下敌方随从，使其消失"
##    - "选择1个敌方随从，使其破坏"
## 5. 属性强化与词条赋予：
##    - "使其他「种族」随从获得+X/+Y" / "选择1个友方随从，使其获得+X/+Y"
##    - "使其获得【守护】" / "使场上所有『卡名』获得【守护】"
## 6. 资源操作：
##    - "骨头+X" / "能量+X" / "你使用的下一张「种族」随从卡能量-X"

static func parse_clauses(effect_text: String) -> Array[Dictionary]:
	var actions: Array[Dictionary] = []
	var cleaned: String = effect_text.replace("\n", "。").replace("；", "。")
	var sentences: PackedStringArray = cleaned.split("。", false)
	for raw_s in sentences:
		var s: String = raw_s.strip_edges()
		if s == "":
			continue
		# 骨头+X
		if s.find("骨头+") != -1:
			var idx: int = s.find("骨头+") + 3
			var val: int = max(1, s.substr(idx).to_int())
			actions.append({"op": "add_bones", "value": val})
		# 抽取X张卡牌
		if s.find("抽取") != -1 and s.find("张") != -1:
			var val: int = 1
			for ch_i in range(s.length()):
				if s.substr(ch_i, 1).is_valid_int():
					val = s.substr(ch_i, 1).to_int()
					break
			actions.append({"op": "draw", "count": val})
		# 对对手的战场上的所有随从造成X点伤害
		if (s.find("所有随从") != -1 or s.find("随从全体") != -1) and s.find("伤害") != -1:
			var dmg: int = _extract_first_int(s, 3)
			actions.append({"op": "aoe_enemy_minions", "damage": dmg})
		# 选择1个敌方随从造成X点伤害
		elif (s.find("1个随从") != -1 or s.find("1个敌方随从") != -1) and s.find("伤害") != -1:
			var dmg: int = _extract_first_int(s.substr(s.find("造成")), 3)
			actions.append({"op": "damage_target_minion", "damage": dmg})
		# 回复自己的主战者X点生命值
		if s.find("回复") != -1 and s.find("主战者") != -1:
			var heal: int = _extract_first_int(s, 3)
			actions.append({"op": "heal_leader", "amount": heal})
	return actions

static func _extract_first_int(txt: String, default_val: int = 1) -> int:
	var num_str: String = ""
	for i in range(txt.length()):
		var c: String = txt.substr(i, 1)
		if c.is_valid_int():
			num_str += c
		elif num_str != "":
			break
	return num_str.to_int() if num_str != "" else default_val
BattleView.gd:
class_name BattleView
extends Control
## 影之诗 × 邪恶冥刻风格核心对战界面控制器 (BattleView)
## 完整实现：
## 1. 起手 4 张换牌调度弹窗（Mulligan，确保「使命必达小子」起手必在）
## 2. 5 列战道实时对位展示、点击空位或献祭后放置随从、点击场上随从发动【启动】能力
## 3. 多阶段流畅出牌交互状态机：选择手牌 -> 选择【抉择】分支 -> 选择【献祭】友方随从 -> 选择【法术/入场曲目标】 -> 选择放置列
## 4. 实时三维资源仪表盘（能量水晶、骨头计数器、墓地与已破坏谢幕曲计数、连击计数）与飘字打击 Tween 动画

signal exit_battle_requested()

enum PlayStep {
	IDLE,
	SELECT_CHOICE,
	SELECT_SACRIFICE,
	SELECT_EFFECT_TARGET,
	SELECT_HAND_TARGET,
	SELECT_LANE
}

var engine: BattleEngine
var _step: PlayStep = PlayStep.IDLE
var _pending_card: CardInstance = null
var _pending_choice_idx: int = 0
var _pending_sac_lanes: Array[int] = []
var _pending_effect_target_lane: int = -1
var _pending_hand_target_uid: int = -1

var _enemy_leader_lbl: Label
var _player_leader_lbl: Label
var _prompt_banner: Label
var _enemy_lanes_hbox: HBoxContainer
var _player_lanes_hbox: HBoxContainer
var _hand_hbox: HBoxContainer
var _log_box: RichTextLabel
var _card_inspector: RichTextLabel
var _choice_overlay: PanelContainer
var _choice_vbox: VBoxContainer
var _mulligan_overlay: PanelContainer
var _mulligan_hbox: HBoxContainer
var _mulligan_selected: Array[int] = []
var _end_turn_btn: Button

func _ready() -> void:
	engine = BattleEngine.new()
	add_child(engine)
	engine.state_updated.connect(_refresh_ui)
	engine.battle_log_added.connect(_on_battle_log)
	engine.floating_text_requested.connect(_on_floating_text)
	engine.game_over_triggered.connect(_on_game_over)
	_build_ui()
	_start_new_match()

func _start_new_match() -> void:
	var p_deck: Array[String] = DeckManager.expand_deck_to_id_list(DeckManager.get_current_deck())
	# 为敌方 AI 随机挑选一套预设主题卡组
	var ai_idx: int = 0 # 敌方AI固定使用全套40张「赛博机械狂潮」机械卡组
	var e_deck: Array[String] = DeckManager.expand_deck_to_id_list(DeckManager.decks[ai_idx])
	engine.start_battle(p_deck, e_deck)
	_show_mulligan_popup()
	_refresh_ui()

func _build_ui() -> void:
	var bg := ColorRect.new()
	bg.color = Color(0.05, 0.07, 0.12)
	bg.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	add_child(bg)

	var main_hbox := HBoxContainer.new()
	main_hbox.set_anchors_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
	main_hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	add_child(main_hbox)

	# 左侧战报与卡牌放大检视栏
	var left_panel := PanelContainer.new()
	left_panel.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(310, 0)
	main_hbox.add_child(left_panel)

	var left_vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	left_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	left_panel.add_child(left_vbox)

	var top_btns := HBoxContainer.new()
	left_vbox.add_child(top_btns)

	var btn_exit := Button.new()
	btn_exit.text = "◀ 撤退返回"
	btn_exit.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		AudioManager.play_sfx("click")
		exit_battle_requested.emit()
	)
	top_btns.add_child(btn_exit)

	var btn_rematch := Button.new()
	btn_rematch.text = "🔄 重新开局"
	btn_rematch.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		AudioManager.play_sfx("turn")
		_log_box.clear()
		_start_new_match()
	)
	top_btns.add_child(btn_rematch)

	_card_inspector = RichTextLabel.new()
	_card_inspector.bbcode_enabled = true
	_card_inspector.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 210)
	_card_inspector.text = "[b]🔍 卡牌详情检视[/b]\n将鼠标悬停在任意手牌或战场随从上查看完整效果。"
	left_vbox.add_child(_card_inspector)

	var log_title := Label.new()
	log_title.text = "📜 实时战斗结算记录"
	left_vbox.add_child(log_title)

	_log_box = RichTextLabel.new()
	_log_box.bbcode_enabled = true
	_log_box.scroll_following = true
	_log_box.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	left_vbox.add_child(_log_box)

	# 右侧主战场区（敌方信息栏 -> 敌方5列战道 -> 交互提示条 -> 我方5列战道 -> 我方资源与手牌栏）
	var center_vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	center_vbox.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	center_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 8)
	main_hbox.add_child(center_vbox)

	# 敌方主战者状态栏
	var enemy_bar := PanelContainer.new()
	enemy_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 44)
	center_vbox.add_child(enemy_bar)
	_enemy_leader_lbl = Label.new()
	_enemy_leader_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	enemy_bar.add_child(_enemy_leader_lbl)

	# 敌方 5 列战道
	_enemy_lanes_hbox = HBoxContainer.new()
	_enemy_lanes_hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_enemy_lanes_hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	_enemy_lanes_hbox.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 185)
	center_vbox.add_child(_enemy_lanes_hbox)

	# 中央交互操作提示横幅 + 结束回合按钮
	var mid_bar := HBoxContainer.new()
	mid_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 42)
	center_vbox.add_child(mid_bar)

	_prompt_banner = Label.new()
	_prompt_banner.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_prompt_banner.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	_prompt_banner.modulate = Color(1.0, 0.88, 0.38)
	mid_bar.add_child(_prompt_banner)

	var btn_cancel := Button.new()
	btn_cancel.text = "取消选牌 (右键)"
	btn_cancel.pressed.connect(_cancel_pending_play)
	mid_bar.add_child(btn_cancel)

	_end_turn_btn = Button.new()
	_end_turn_btn.text = "⏳ 结束回合"
	_end_turn_btn.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(150, 40)
	_end_turn_btn.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
		if engine.active_side == BattleEngine.PLAYER and not engine.is_game_over:
			_cancel_pending_play()
			AudioManager.play_sfx("turn")
			engine.end_turn(BattleEngine.PLAYER)
	)
	mid_bar.add_child(_end_turn_btn)

	# 我方 5 列战道
	_player_lanes_hbox = HBoxContainer.new()
	_player_lanes_hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_player_lanes_hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 18)
	_player_lanes_hbox.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 185)
	center_vbox.add_child(_player_lanes_hbox)

	# 我方主战者三维资源状态栏
	var player_bar := PanelContainer.new()
	player_bar.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(0, 46)
	center_vbox.add_child(player_bar)
	_player_leader_lbl = Label.new()
	_player_leader_lbl.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 16)
	player_bar.add_child(_player_leader_lbl)

	# 我方底部手牌区
	var hand_scroll := ScrollContainer.new()
	hand_scroll.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	center_vbox.add_child(hand_scroll)

	_hand_hbox = HBoxContainer.new()
	_hand_hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_hand_hbox.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
	_hand_hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 10)
	hand_scroll.add_child(_hand_hbox)

	# 【抉择】弹窗浮层
	_choice_overlay = PanelContainer.new()
	_choice_overlay.visible = false
	_choice_overlay.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(520, 220)
	_choice_overlay.position = Vector2(540, 300)
	add_child(_choice_overlay)
	_choice_vbox = VBoxContainer.new()
	_choice_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 12)
	_choice_overlay.add_child(_choice_vbox)

	# 起手 4 张换牌调度弹窗浮层
	_mulligan_overlay = PanelContainer.new()
	_mulligan_overlay.visible = false
	_mulligan_overlay.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(760, 340)
	_mulligan_overlay.position = Vector2(420, 240)
	add_child(_mulligan_overlay)
	var mul_vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
	mul_vbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 14)
	_mulligan_overlay.add_child(mul_vbox)
	var mul_title := Label.new()
	mul_title.text = "🎴 起手换牌调度：点击勾选想要替换回牌库的卡牌（【使命必达小子】必在起手中）"
	mul_title.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	mul_vbox.add_child(mul_title)
	_mulligan_hbox = HBoxContainer.new()
	_mulligan_hbox.alignment = BoxContainer.ALIGNMENT_CENTER
	_mulligan_hbox.add_theme_constant_override("separation", 16)
	mul_vbox.add_child(_mulligan_hbox)
	var mul_confirm := Button.new()
	mul_confirm.text = "✅ 确认起手手牌并开始第 1 回合"
	mul_confirm.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(260, 42)
	mul_confirm.pressed.connect(_confirm_mulligan)
	mul_vbox.add_child(mul_confirm)

func _show_mulligan_popup() -> void:
	_mulligan_selected.clear()
	_mulligan_overlay.visible = true
	_rebuild_mulligan_cards()

func _rebuild_mulligan_cards() -> void:
	for c in _mulligan_hbox.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	var hand: Array = engine.leaders[BattleEngine.PLAYER]["hand"]
	for i in range(hand.size()):
		var inst: CardInstance = hand[i]
		var vbox := VBoxContainer.new()
		var cv := CardView.new()
		cv.setup_from_instance(inst, "hand")
		cv.is_selected = _mulligan_selected.has(i)
		var idx: int = i
		cv.card_clicked.connect(func(_v: CardView) -> void:
			if _mulligan_selected.has(idx):
				_mulligan_selected.erase(idx)
			else:
				_mulligan_selected.append(idx)
			AudioManager.play_sfx("click")
			_rebuild_mulligan_cards()
		)
		vbox.add_child(cv)
		var tag := Label.new()
		tag.horizontal_alignment = HORIZONTAL_ALIGNMENT_CENTER
		tag.text = "🔄 替换此牌" if _mulligan_selected.has(i) else "✔️ 保留"
		vbox.add_child(tag)
		_mulligan_hbox.add_child(vbox)

func _confirm_mulligan() -> void:
	_mulligan_overlay.visible = false
	engine.perform_mulligan(BattleEngine.PLAYER, _mulligan_selected)
	engine.begin_turn(BattleEngine.PLAYER)

func _refresh_ui() -> void:
	var pst: Dictionary = engine.leaders[BattleEngine.PLAYER]
	var est: Dictionary = engine.leaders[BattleEngine.ENEMY]

	_enemy_leader_lbl.text = "👹 敌方主战者  ❤️ 生命: %d/%d  |  ⚡ 能量: %d/%d  |  🦴 骨头: %d  |  🃏 手牌: %d  |  牌库: %d  |  墓地: %d" % [
		int(est["hp"]), int(est["max_hp"]),
		int(est["energy"]), int(est["max_energy"]),
		int(est["bones"]),
		est["hand"].size(), est["deck"].size(), est["graveyard"].size()
	]
	_player_leader_lbl.text = "🛡️ 我方主战者  ❤️ 生命: %d/%d  |  ⚡ 能量: %d/%d  |  🦴 骨头: %d  |  🔥 本回合连击: %d  |  ⚰️ 已破坏谢幕曲: %d  |  牌库: %d" % [
		int(pst["hp"]), int(pst["max_hp"]),
		int(pst["energy"]), int(pst["max_energy"]),
		int(pst["bones"]),
		int(pst["cards_played_this_turn"]),
		int(pst["destroyed_last_words_count"]),
		pst["deck"].size()
	]

	_update_prompt_banner()
	_rebuild_lanes()
	_rebuild_hand()

func _update_prompt_banner() -> void:
	if engine.is_game_over:
		return
	match _step:
		PlayStep.IDLE:
			_prompt_banner.text = "💡 你的回合：点击下方绿色发光手牌出牌（随从放置后将立即对前方发起攻击），或点击场上【赛博牧羊人】发动【启动】能力。"
		PlayStep.SELECT_CHOICE:
			_prompt_banner.text = "⚖️ 请在弹窗中选择【%s】的【抉择】发动分支..." % _pending_card.data.name
		PlayStep.SELECT_SACRIFICE:
			var need: int = _pending_card.data.sacrifice
			var cond: String = _pending_card.data.sacrifice_cond
			_prompt_banner.text = "🩸 献祭阶段：请点击我方战场上 %d 个%s随从作为祭品（已选 %d/%d）" % [
				need, ("「%s」" % cond if cond != "" else ""), _pending_sac_lanes.size(), need
			]
		PlayStep.SELECT_EFFECT_TARGET:
			_prompt_banner.text = "🎯 目标指定：请点击战场上高亮的目标随从以结算【%s】的效果" % _pending_card.data.name
		PlayStep.SELECT_HAND_TARGET:
			_prompt_banner.text = "🃏 手牌选择：请点击下方 1 张其他手牌洗回牌库（【%s】入场曲）" % _pending_card.data.name
		PlayStep.SELECT_LANE:
			_prompt_banner.text = "📍 战道部署：请点击我方 5 列战道中的任意空位（或刚才选定的祭品位置）放置【%s】" % _pending_card.data.name

func _rebuild_lanes() -> void:
	for c in _enemy_lanes_hbox.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	for c in _player_lanes_hbox.get_children():
		c.queue_free()

	for lane in range(BattleEngine.LANES):
		_enemy_lanes_hbox.add_child(_create_lane_slot(BattleEngine.ENEMY, lane))
		_player_lanes_hbox.add_child(_create_lane_slot(BattleEngine.PLAYER, lane))

func _create_lane_slot(side: int, lane: int) -> Control:
	var slot := PanelContainer.new()
	slot.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(150, 178)
	var m: CardInstance = engine.board[side][lane]
	if m != null:
		var cv := CardView.new()
		cv.setup_from_instance(m, "board")
		if side == BattleEngine.PLAYER and _step == PlayStep.SELECT_SACRIFICE:
			var valid_s: Array[int] = engine.get_valid_sacrifice_lanes(BattleEngine.PLAYER, _pending_card.data.sacrifice_cond)
			cv.is_sacrifice_candidate = valid_s.has(lane)
			cv.is_selected = _pending_sac_lanes.has(lane)
		cv.card_clicked.connect(func(_v: CardView) -> void:
			_on_lane_clicked(side, lane)
		)
		cv.card_hovered.connect(func(_v: CardView, hov: bool) -> void:
			if hov:
				_inspect_instance(m)
		)
		slot.add_child(cv)
	else:
		var empty_btn := Button.new()
		empty_btn.text = "%s战道 %d\n[空位]" % ["敌方" if side == BattleEngine.ENEMY else "我方", lane + 1]
		empty_btn.size_flags_horizontal = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		empty_btn.size_flags_vertical = Control.SIZE_EXPAND_FILL
		empty_btn.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			_on_lane_clicked(side, lane)
		)
		slot.add_child(empty_btn)
	return slot

func _rebuild_hand() -> void:
	for c in _hand_hbox.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	var hand: Array = engine.leaders[BattleEngine.PLAYER]["hand"]
	for inst in hand:
		var cv := CardView.new()
		cv.setup_from_instance(inst, "hand")
		var check: Dictionary = engine.can_play_card(BattleEngine.PLAYER, inst)
		cv.is_playable = (engine.active_side == BattleEngine.PLAYER and bool(check.get("ok", false)))
		cv.is_selected = (_pending_card == inst)
		cv.card_clicked.connect(func(_v: CardView) -> void:
			_on_hand_card_clicked(inst)
		)
		cv.card_right_clicked.connect(func(_v: CardView) -> void:
			_cancel_pending_play()
		)
		cv.card_hovered.connect(func(_v: CardView, hov: bool) -> void:
			if hov:
				_inspect_instance(inst)
		)
		_hand_hbox.add_child(cv)

## 点击手牌时的多阶段状态流转
func _on_hand_card_clicked(inst: CardInstance) -> void:
	if engine.active_side != BattleEngine.PLAYER or engine.is_game_over:
		return
	# 若当前处于「滑板跃迁手」选择一张其他手牌洗入牌库的步骤
	if _step == PlayStep.SELECT_HAND_TARGET and inst != _pending_card:
		_pending_hand_target_uid = inst.uid
		_advance_play_pipeline()
		return

	var check: Dictionary = engine.can_play_card(BattleEngine.PLAYER, inst)
	if not bool(check.get("ok", false)):
		_prompt_banner.text = "⚠️ 无法打出【%s】：%s" % [inst.data.name, str(check.get("reason", ""))]
		AudioManager.play_sfx("hit")
		return

	_pending_card = inst
	_pending_choice_idx = 0
	_pending_sac_lanes.clear()
	_pending_effect_target_lane = -1
	_pending_hand_target_uid = -1
	AudioManager.play_sfx("click")

	# 检查是否包含【抉择】
	var choices: Array = engine.get_card_choices(inst)
	if not choices.is_empty():
		_step = PlayStep.SELECT_CHOICE
		_show_choice_popup(inst, choices)
		_refresh_ui()
		return

	_advance_play_pipeline()

func _show_choice_popup(inst: CardInstance, choices: Array) -> void:
	for c in _choice_vbox.get_children():
		c.queue_free()
	var title := Label.new()
	title.text = "⚖️ 请选择【%s】要发动的【抉择】能力：" % inst.data.name
	_choice_vbox.add_child(title)
	for i in range(choices.size()):
		var opt: Dictionary = choices[i]
		var opt_txt: String = str(opt.get("t", ""))
		if opt_txt == "":
			var reans: Array = opt.get("reans", [])
			if not reans.is_empty():
				var r0: Dictionary = reans[0]
				opt_txt = "【%s_能量%d】仅限「%s」%s" % [
					str(r0.get("k", "")),
					int(r0.get("costs", {}).get("energy", 0)),
					str(r0.get("type", "")),
					str(r0.get("effect", ""))
				]
		var b := Button.new()
		b.text = "选项 (%d)：%s" % [i + 1, opt_txt]
		b.custom_minimum_size = Vector2(460, 44)
		var pick_idx: int = i
		b.pressed.connect(func() -> void:
			_pending_choice_idx = pick_idx
			_choice_overlay.visible = false
			AudioManager.play_sfx("click")
			_advance_play_pipeline()
		)
		_choice_vbox.add_child(b)
	_choice_overlay.visible = true

## 自动推进出牌流水线：献祭 -> 手牌目标 -> 战场目标 -> 选择战道放置（或法术直接释放）
func _advance_play_pipeline() -> void:
	if _pending_card == null:
		return

	# 1. 是否还需要选择献祭随从
	if _pending_card.data.sacrifice > _pending_sac_lanes.size():
		_step = PlayStep.SELECT_SACRIFICE
		_refresh_ui()
		return

	# 2. 是否需要选择另一张手牌（如「滑板跃迁手」）
	var is_enh: bool = (engine.will_trigger_enhance(BattleEngine.PLAYER, _pending_card) > 0)
	var req: String = engine.get_card_target_requirement(_pending_card, is_enh)
	var hand: Array = engine.leaders[BattleEngine.PLAYER]["hand"]
	if req == "hand_card" and _pending_hand_target_uid == -1 and hand.size() > 1:
		_step = PlayStep.SELECT_HAND_TARGET
		_refresh_ui()
		return

	# 3. 是否需要指定战场上的敌方/友方随从目标
	if req in ["enemy_minion", "enemy_minion_hp3", "friendly_minion"] and _pending_effect_target_lane == -1:
		var valid_lanes: Array[int] = engine.get_valid_target_lanes(BattleEngine.PLAYER, req, _pending_card.data.type == "spell")
		if not valid_lanes.is_empty():
			_step = PlayStep.SELECT_EFFECT_TARGET
			_refresh_ui()
			return
		elif _pending_card.data.type == "spell":
			_prompt_banner.text = "⚠️ 场上有合法目标时才能使用法术【%s】！" % _pending_card.data.name
			_cancel_pending_play()
			return

	# 4. 若是法术，无需选择放置列，立即结算
	if _pending_card.data.type == "spell":
		engine.play_card_from_hand(
			BattleEngine.PLAYER,
			_pending_card,
			0,
			_pending_sac_lanes,
			_pending_effect_target_lane,
			_pending_choice_idx,
			_pending_hand_target_uid
		)
		_cancel_pending_play()
		return

	# 5. 若是随从，进入选择我方战道列步骤
	_step = PlayStep.SELECT_LANE
	_refresh_ui()

## 点击我方或敌方战道列时的响应
func _on_lane_clicked(side: int, lane: int) -> void:
	if engine.active_side != BattleEngine.PLAYER or engine.is_game_over:
		return

	match _step:
		PlayStep.IDLE:
			# 空闲状态下点击我方随从可尝试触发其【启动】能力（如「赛博牧羊人」）
			if side == BattleEngine.PLAYER and engine.board[side][lane] != null:
				if not engine.activate_minion_ability(BattleEngine.PLAYER, lane):
					_inspect_instance(engine.board[side][lane])

		PlayStep.SELECT_SACRIFICE:
			if side == BattleEngine.PLAYER and engine.board[side][lane] != null:
				var valid_s: Array[int] = engine.get_valid_sacrifice_lanes(BattleEngine.PLAYER, _pending_card.data.sacrifice_cond)
				if valid_s.has(lane):
					if _pending_sac_lanes.has(lane):
						_pending_sac_lanes.erase(lane)
					else:
						_pending_sac_lanes.append(lane)
					AudioManager.play_sfx("click")
					_advance_play_pipeline()

		PlayStep.SELECT_EFFECT_TARGET:
			var is_enh: bool = (engine.will_trigger_enhance(BattleEngine.PLAYER, _pending_card) > 0)
			var req: String = engine.get_card_target_requirement(_pending_card, is_enh)
			var expected_side: int = BattleEngine.PLAYER if req == "friendly_minion" else BattleEngine.ENEMY
			var valid_t: Array[int] = engine.get_valid_target_lanes(BattleEngine.PLAYER, req, _pending_card.data.type == "spell")
			if side == expected_side and valid_t.has(lane):
				_pending_effect_target_lane = lane
				AudioManager.play_sfx("click")
				_advance_play_pipeline()

		PlayStep.SELECT_LANE:
			if side == BattleEngine.PLAYER:
				if engine.board[side][lane] == null or _pending_sac_lanes.has(lane):
					engine.play_card_from_hand(
						BattleEngine.PLAYER,
						_pending_card,
						lane,
						_pending_sac_lanes,
						_pending_effect_target_lane,
						_pending_choice_idx,
						_pending_hand_target_uid
					)
					_cancel_pending_play()

func _cancel_pending_play() -> void:
	_step = PlayStep.IDLE
	_pending_card = null
	_pending_sac_lanes.clear()
	_pending_effect_target_lane = -1
	_pending_hand_target_uid = -1
	_choice_overlay.visible = false
	_refresh_ui()

func _inspect_instance(inst: CardInstance) -> void:
	if inst == null:
		return
	var c: CardData = inst.data
	var badges: String = "、".join(inst.get_badge_list())
	_card_inspector.text = "[b]【%s】[/b] (%s)\n⚡能量:%d | 🩸献祭:%d | 🦴骨头:%d\n⚔️当前攻击:%d  ❤️当前生命:%d/%d\n🏷️词条状态:%s\n[color=#ffe89e]%s[/color]" % [
		c.name, c.get_type_cn(),
		inst.get_effective_energy(), c.sacrifice, c.bones,
		inst.current_atk, inst.current_hp, inst.max_hp,
		(badges if badges != "" else "无"),
		c.get_display_text()
	]

func _on_battle_log(msg: String) -> void:
	_log_box.append_text(msg + "\n")

func _on_floating_text(side: int, lane: int, text: String, col: Color) -> void:
	var floater := Label.new()
	floater.text = text
	floater.add_theme_font_size_override("font_size", 22)
	floater.modulate = col
	var base_x: float = 520.0 + float(max(0, lane)) * 165.0
	var base_y: float = 420.0 if side == BattleEngine.PLAYER else 170.0
	floater.position = Vector2(base_x, base_y)
	add_child(floater)
	var tw: Tween = create_tween().set_parallel(true)
	tw.tween_property(floater, "position:y", base_y - 48.0, 0.75)
	tw.tween_property(floater, "modulate:a", 0.0, 0.75)
	tw.chain().tween_callback(floater.queue_free)

func _on_game_over(winner_side: int, reason: String) -> void:
	var title_str: String = "🏆 胜利！你击败了对手！" if winner_side == BattleEngine.PLAYER else "💀 战败！请调整构筑再战！"
	_prompt_banner.text = "%s （%s）—— 点击左上角「重新开局」或「撤退返回」" % [title_str, reason]
